{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
trial_data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
trial_data = trial_data.loc[trial_data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Identify and handle sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_value = -999.0
mask = trial_data['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value

# Count and report sentinel values
num_sentinels = mask.sum()
print(f"Number of sentinel values in biomarker_baseline: {num_sentinels}")

# Replace sentinel values with NaN for proper mean calculation
trial_data_clean = trial_data.copy()
trial_data_clean.loc[mask, 'biomarker_baseline'] = pd.NA

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value, excluding sentinel values
mean_biomarker = trial_data_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (excluding sentinel values): {mean_biomarker}")"}
